purpose: Second research cycle after readiness layer: remaining operational painpoints to convert into shipped surfaces.

gaps.why: agents reuse stale docs, old CLI names, and outdated connector assumptions
multi-agent work fails when owner/evidence/acceptance/dependencies are implicit
agents need reviewable patch summaries, tests, risks, rollback notes
agents waste loops rerunning without classifying infra/test/code flakes
connectors fail or leak when required scopes/env vars are unclear
agents need budget envelopes and context compression rules
parallel agents duplicate work or miss dependencies without a shared ledger
